title: Annetta Knowles
subtitle: The Stained Priestess
text: She was among the highest-ranking members of the Unstained — a cleric who had given her life to purification. Her downfall came from a single impossible fact: Tooth Pecks sought her through every ward. They seek active infection, not the mundane residue carried by most people. If they would not leave her, she was infected. If she was infected, had any of her purification been real? Her sanity broke under the weight of that question, and the latent blood power she had spent years suppressing came flooding out all at once. She is not the Pale Lady. The Lady is a non-physical force of nature. Annetta is a person — a broken person with enormous and terrible power.
